title: Patrick Stewart dies – level 2
paragraphs: Famous British actor Sir Patrick Stewart passed away at the age of 86. Many friends and fans are sharing kind words about his life and work. Actor Ian McKellen called him a deeply loved and respected friend.

Stewart became famous around the world for his main roles in Star Trek and the X-Men movies, but he also loved playing in classical theater and performed in many famous Shakespeare plays in Britain. People who worked with him say he was a very talented, kind, and hardworking actor who made deep stories easy for everyone to enjoy.
Fans will always remember his great voice, his classic movies, and his famous theater roles.

words.d: to act, sing, dance, or play music in front of people
